findings.title: The SKILL loop rule had no referent on the first exit 3
findings.action: Say the first exit 3 always re-invokes
findings.disposition_rationale: d8969949 adds (the first exit 3 always re-invokes). Phase 2 raised the same point independently.

findings.title: The chunked-calls paragraph was merged into the judge paragraph to fit the baseline
findings.action: Add the blank line and raise the baseline by one more
findings.disposition_rationale: d8969949 adds the blank line; faff-graft baseline 960 with a FAFF-1246 +2 note.

findings.title: An unchanged resume keeps outage parks
findings.disposition_rationale: Spec-chosen so retries stay bounded across calls; the failure direction is park. Recorded on FAFF-1249.

findings.title: A budget below one attempt silently degrades the loop to always parking
findings.disposition_rationale: The progress guarantee (the first attempt always runs) is a spec decision; a stderr advisory names both numbers, and the outcome is a park, never an admit.

findings.title: Concurrent --assemble invocations race on the ledger
findings.action: Add a lock or epoch check
findings.disposition_rationale: graft runs --assemble sequentially by design; an overlap can only re-spend attempts, and the FAFF-1248 bindings still guard --admit.

findings.title: dispatched overcounts on a resumed ledger
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec pins dispatched to its fresh-assembly meaning; progress across calls is read from attempts_remaining and the ledger.
